stories: EUR/NZD broke out of the range it had kept to earlier in the day, so the bot sold it. But the price turned round and reached the safety stop. It closed at -1.4 pips (-£2.74).

EUR/AUD broke through a level, came back to touch it once, then moved away again, so the bot sold it. But the move did not carry on - it turned back - so the bot got out quickly. It closed at -0.8 pips (-£1.84).

CHF/JPY broke out of the range it had kept to earlier in the day, so the bot bought it. It moved far enough for the bot to move the safety stop up behind it (it never moves it back). When the price came back to the stop, the trade closed at +3.1 pips (+£1.95).

GBP/CAD broke through a level, came back to touch it once, then moved away again, so the bot bought it. It moved far enough for the bot to move the safety stop up behind it (it never moves it back). When the price came back to the stop, the trade closed at +6.6 pips (+£5.60).

EUR/USD broke below the edge of where it had been stuck and was moving fast, so the bot sold it. It moved far enough for the bot to move the safety stop down behind it (it never moves it back). When the price came back to the stop, the trade closed at -2.7 pips (-£3.37).

GBP/USD broke above the edge of where it had been stuck and was moving fast, so the bot bought it. But the move did not carry on - it turned back - so the bot got out quickly. It closed at -4.2 pips (-£4.85).

EUR/CAD broke below the edge of where it had been stuck and was moving fast, so the bot sold it. It moved far enough for the bot to move the safety stop down behind it (it never moves it back). When the price came back to the stop, the trade closed at -3.5 pips (-£4.56).

CAD/CHF broke above the edge of where it had been stuck and was moving fast, so the bot bought it. But the move did not carry on - it turned back - so the bot got out quickly. It closed at -0.9 pips (-£1.50).
